Government of India
Ministry of Commerce & Industry
Department of Commerce
Directorate General of Foreign Trade
Vanijya Bhawan, New Delhi
Notification No. 52 /2025-26
Dated: December 31, 2025
Subject: Amendment for extension of validity of Minimum Export Price (MEP)
on export of Natural Honey — regarding.
S.O. (E): In exercise of powers conferred by Section 3 read with Section 5 of the
Foreign Trade (Development & Regulation) Act, 1992 read with Para 1.02 and 2.01 of
the Foreign Trade Policy, 2023, as amended from time to time, and in amendment of
the earlier Notification No. 27/2025-26 dated 22.08.2025, the Central Government
hereby extends the validity of the existing Minimum Export Price condition of Natural
Honey under ITC(HS) code 04090000 of Schedule-I! (Export Policy), as under, with
immediate effect:—

2m. Effect of this Notification:
Minimum Export Price (MEP) on Natural Honey (exported under ITC HS Code
04090000) shall remain at US Dollar 1400 FOB per Metric Ton till 318 March 2026, with
immediate effect.
